name: PR detail shows the seeded review run, verdict, findings, and the severity filter
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and confirm the seeded review run renders (verdict 'request changes', 2 findings) in its accordion header. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner, the SeverityFilter chip row and the seeded FindingCard ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') are revealed without an extra click. Then exercises the severity ISOLATE filter, which lives in that run's FindingsPanel toolbar (one chip row per review run, local state — there is deliberately NO filter above TIMELINE): the seed has exactly 1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING, so the chips read 'Critical 1 / Warning 1' and 'Suggestion 0' is dimmed and unclickable. Clicking Critical leaves the CRITICAL finding visible. This asserts the MECHANICS only — the harness has positive locators, so the WARNING card's disappearance is not expressible here; the filtering semantics are covered by FindingsPanel.test.tsx. Exercises ReviewRunAccordion / VerdictBanner / FindingsPanel / FindingCard / SeverityFilter. Read-only seeded data (no model call). NOTE: the seeded review has run_id = null, so it produces no timeline row — the per-run timeline counters are not reachable here and are covered by client unit tests instead. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
